title: Reservation service design note
text: A hold consumes available capacity while active. Confirmation makes the reservation durable. Expired unconfirmed holds release capacity.

title: Idempotency design note
text: A repeated request with the same idempotency key and identical item and quantity returns the original hold. A conflicting request returns an error.

title: Concurrency design note
text: The inventory capacity check and hold creation occur under one lock, preventing concurrent requests from overselling a single process.
